name: lint_count
title: Lint Count
description: Count of lints identified by lintr. The set of linters applied is controlled by the lint_linters option, which defaults to linters from the correctness, common_mistakes, and robustness tags excluding those that require configuration or are environment-dependent. Lower counts indicate higher code quality.

name: has_current_news
title: Up to date NEWS
description: a NEWS file exists and is synced with the current package version

name: lint_free_fraction
title: Lint-Free Fraction
description: Fraction of R code lines that are free of lints. Code lines are defined as lines containing executable R tokens (excluding comments and blank lines) across the standard package directories (R/, tests/, inst/, vignettes/, data-raw/, demo/, exec/). A value of 1 means no linted lines; lower values indicate more pervasive lint issues. The set of linters applied is controlled by the lint_linters option.

name: cran_reverse_dependencies_count
title: CRAN Reverse Dependencies Count
description: The number of packages on CRAN that directly depend on this package through Depends, Imports, or LinkingTo fields. This metric reflects adoption within the CRAN ecosystem and indicates how many packages would be affected by breaking changes. Higher counts suggest wider usage and community trust, but also greater responsibility for maintaining backward compatibility.

name: r_cmd_check_error_count
title: R CMD check Error Count
description: the number of errors produced when running R CMD check

name: test_line_coverage_fraction
title: Test coverage of package code by line
description: The fraction of lines of package code that are evaluated by any test

name: exports_help_coverage
title: Exports Help Coverage
description: The fraction of exported objects that have help pages. Calculated by matching package exports against \alias tags in help pages. Values range from 0.0 (no exports documented) to 1.0 (all exports have help pages).

name: test_expression_coverage_fraction
title: Test coverage of package code by expression
description: The fraction of expressions of package code that are evaluated by any test

name: downloads_total
title: Total Downloads
description: total number of lifetime downloads, as reported by the Posit CRAN mirror through the cranlogs API

name: help_pages_with_examples_count
title: Help Pages with Examples Count
description: The number of help pages that include an \examples section. This provides an absolute count of how many documentation pages demonstrate the package functionality with example code.

name: has_recognized_source
title: Has Recognized Source Repository
description: Indicates whether the package has a source code repository on a recognized hosting platform from an allow-list of known domains. Inferred from the URL and BugReports fields in the DESCRIPTION file. See ?options for customizing the allow-list.

name: help_examples_coverage
title: Help Pages Examples Coverage
description: The fraction of help pages that include an \examples section. Calculated as the number of help pages with examples divided by the total number of help pages. Values range from 0.0 (no examples) to 1.0 (all pages have examples).

name: has_website
title: Has Website
description: a logical indicating whether the package has a website
